name: MeteoAlarm Terms and Conditions
content: All Information on the MeteoAlarm Website may be used and redistributed under terms equivalent to the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License, with additional requirements: modified information is redistributed along with the same information without any material change; the source is EUMETNET – MeteoAlarm and, for the information of one country, the relevant MeteoAlarm Participant (National Meteorological and Hydrological Service); the issuing time and a link to www.meteoalarm.org are displayed; time delays between this app and the www.meteoalarm.org website are possible, and for the most up-to-date awareness information as published by the participating National Meteorological and Hydrological Services, please refer to www.meteoalarm.org.
